name: Claude in Chrome
desc: Chrome extension where Claude browses and acts on pages
desc_zh: 让 Claude 在浏览器里读网页、点按钮办事的扩展
solves: Web tasks mean endless tab switching and copy-paste; Claude in Chrome reads the page and does the clicks for you.
solves_zh: 网页操作要不停切标签、复制粘贴，Claude in Chrome 读懂页面后替你点。
best_for: You must file the same form in a legacy admin portal and would rather not click through it again.
best_for_zh: 又要在老旧后台里填同一张表单，不想再逐项点一遍。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://www.anthropic.com/news/product and https://claude.com/resources/arti）。 Outside the window. An invite-only pilot with 1,000 Max plan users (waitlist) ran for about three months before; 2025-08-25 is the first day all Max plan subscribers could use it (beta). The article was later updated to say it is generally available. Second source is not independent media. 首次公开日期来源：https://claude.com/resources/articles/claude-for-chrome
